summary: Tested branding refactor: backend categories (6 new slugs), migration (food→date-night, sports/rooftops/events→night-out), and new 3-step flow Home → /vibe → /categories → /c/:slug with vibe URL param round-trip. All 51 backend tests pass (24 new/updated + 27 regression). Frontend flow works end-to-end with correct testids, headings, button text 'I'M DOWN', no 'Nashville' in chrome, vibe param preserved on /c/:slug URL, and back button chain works. Admin regression also passes (admin/me, /admin/analytics/business/{migrated-id}, /admin/categories=6).

issues: Business description copy still says 'Nashville's iconic hot chicken' / addresses are 'Nashville, TN'. Acceptance criterion says 'No Nashville string in public flow' but page chrome (heading/subtitle/back/CTAs) has none — only seeded business content does. Non-blocking; flag for product call on whether seeded copy should also be city-neutral.

action_items: (Optional product call) Decide whether seeded business descriptions/addresses should drop the word 'Nashville' to be fully city-neutral on the public flow. App chrome is clean; only data copy mentions the city.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoryDetailPage: `category-detail-title` is rendered with `{category?.name}` before fetch resolves, briefly producing an empty H1 (~300ms). Consider showing the skeleton until `category` is loaded so title isn't momentarily empty.

CategoryDetailPage: subtitle uses raw count `businesses.length` — pluralization is correct ('1 spot'/'7 spots') but only because of seeded data; verify it really pluralizes when count==1 (current text in code shows it does via ternary).

VibePage trackEvent payload includes `{vibe: vibe.slug}` but backend AnalyticsEvent model has no `vibe` field — extra payload key is silently dropped by FastAPI/Pydantic. Not a bug, but if you ever want to slice analytics by vibe, the model needs a `vibe` field.
Migration block in server.py runs on every startup. Confirmed idempotent in tests, but consider gating with a one-time marker doc to avoid repeated `update_many`s on each restart at scale.
server.py is ~600 lines — consider splitting routes/models/migration into modules per code-review guideline (<700 lines, but trending up).
Backend uses `category_slug` filter that returns empty array for removed slugs (food/sports/rooftops/events) instead of 404 — that is desirable for the FE, just confirming intent.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated EXPECTED_CATEGORIES, added TestCategoryMigration class, TestVibeAnalytics, renamed test_food_category → test_date_night_category, swapped 'food' params to 'date-night' across admin/business/analytics tests, fixed admin_categories count 9→6)
test_credentials: Admin token from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (test_session_admin_1780165861579) still valid after migration.
seed_data_creation: None. Migration ran via supervisor startup; existing seeded businesses verified intact (>=30 non-TEST businesses preserved).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is the authoritative regression suite (51 tests, 9.1s). New category set: drinks, date-night, live-music, night-out, family-fun, surprise-me. Removed: food, sports, rooftops, events. Migrated: food→date-night (7 biz), sports+rooftops+events→night-out (9 biz). Public flow: / → /vibe → /categories?vibe=X → /c/:slug?vibe=X. Vibe param is currently decorative (round-trips URLs only, doesn't filter backend) — that is intentional per main agent.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. One transient empty H1 on /c/:slug noted as minor polish; first Playwright pass mis-read 'category-detail-title' before the network request resolved, second pass with proper wait showed correct 'Date Night' title and '7 spots for you.' subtitle.
